title: Approved pull-request bot identities
description: The allowlist scripts/check-issue-link consults to exempt a pull request's range from the issue-link trailer (req-cicd-issue-link-6). An entry is an identity, not a name: the numeric GitHub account id and the account type Bot authorize; the login is diagnostics. The file is read by a stdlib-only host tool (shape-checked at load, fail-closed) and validated against this schema by tap/tests/test_check_issue_link.py.

description.description: Why this file exists and what is deliberately absent from it.

approved.description: Deliberately approved bot identities. Order is irrelevant; ids are unique.

login.description: The account login as GitHub reports it, for diagnostics and audit. Never used for authorization.

id.description: GitHub's numeric account id (github.event.pull_request.user.id) — the authorizing identity. Taken from GitHub's /users/<login> response, never guessed.

type.description: GitHub account type; only Bot accounts are exemptible (a User with a bot-shaped login is a human).

verified.description: The date the id/type/login triple was read from GitHub.

note.description: Which system this identity is and why it is approved.
